milestones.notes: SHIPPED. The Pressed Sheet graphics overhaul, live on /tours/chicago/hyde-park. One physical language per the council verdict (design/R10/council-verdict.md): the map is a printed survey sheet on a cream-dark desk; grades press DOWN as a true inner-shadow intaglio in four ranked steps stamped at a3-s2 with an on-page disclosure; only true dollars rise UP (act6 deed-stack towers at North Lawndale and East Woodlawn, one disclosed sliver scale, national medians never map-pinned). Ground plane from real layers only: community-areas land/fabric, derived shoreline lake with water-lining, parks, PLSS mile grid clipped to dry land. FLIP camera on the inner data-camera group (user units, transform-box view-box), named real-geometry focus targets, veil spotlights incl. the Binga block from the recorded 5922 South Park coordinate, quantized tilt 0/10/22 (mobile 8), counter-scaled labels with per-camera clip gating. Register rebuilt: full-span lanes, boxed initials, decade rail, the union band split honestly at 1970 with a hatched ONE INSTRUMENT STILL RUNNING continuation, four true-dated baton passes, the S-row 2008 return drawn, ink caret turning rust only at 2026. Process: 6-lens ideation council + peer review + chairman, Wave 0 core + 2 build agents, 5-lens audit (58 findings, 6 p1) + fix wave + 2 fix agents, 3-lens verification round (chairman: FIX-THEN-SHIP, 7 items, all executed). Suite now 110 checks / 16 scenarios, green locally AND against production; shot corpus enumerated from ground-copy.json (60 anchors x 2 widths) with an active-step assert. WEBKIT RECORD (2026-07-11, Playwright WebKit against the live build): ch1 tilt matrix3d applies, a3-s2 press filter url resolves, a6-ledger stands 2 towers at tilt 22, ch6-to-ch5 within-frame flight flies and settles on the Binga crop with transform-box view-box honored, zero page errors. THROTTLED PROD SMOKE (Fast 3G + 4x CPU, mobile viewport, against rooted-forward.org): first map paint 6.6s, engine alive 2.1s, mid-page flood state correct, cold #ch6 deep link lands at once. NOTE the old smoke had been silently measuring localhost through the redirecting construction slug; it now targets the live production slug.
